definition_en: One side of a piece of paper in a book.
example_en: Please open your history textbook to page fifty-five, everyone.
example_uz: Iltimos, hammangiz tarix darsligingizni ellik beshinchi betiga oching.

definition_en: To look carefully for someone or something that is missing.
example_en: They search the forest every day for the lost puppy.
example_uz: Ular har kuni o'rmonda yo'qolgan kuchukchani qidirishadi.

definition_en: Not costing any money to have or use.
example_en: The school provides free books for all of its new students.
example_uz: Maktab barcha yangi o'quvchilari uchun bepul kitoblar bilan ta'minlaydi.

definition_en: Facts or details about a person, event, or situation.
example_en: You can find more information about this course on the website.
example_uz: Ushbu kurs haqida ko'proq ma'lumotni veb-saytdan topishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: New information about events that happen in the world.
example_en: I watched the morning news on television yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha televizorda tonggi yangiliklarni ko'rdim.

definition_en: The activity of making, buying, or selling goods or services for money.
example_en: She decided to start her own business after leaving university.
example_uz: U universitetni tugatgach o'z biznesini boshlashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: An opinion or way of thinking about a particular subject.
example_en: In my view, education is the most important thing for success.
example_uz: Mening fikrimcha, ta'lim muvaffaqiyat uchun eng muhim narsadir.

definition_en: Connected to or available through the internet.
example_en: Many students prefer to take online classes from their home.
example_uz: Ko'p talabalar uydan turib onlayn darslarda qatnashishni ma'qul ko'rishadi.

definition_en: Coming before all others in time or order.
example_en: It was my first time visiting a foreign country last year.
example_uz: O'tgan yili xorijiy davlatga birinchi marta tashrif buyurgan edim.

definition_en: Help or work done by someone for another person or organization.
example_en: The customer was very happy with the service at the hotel.
example_uz: Mijoz mehmonxonadagi xizmatdan juda mamnun bo'ldi.

definition_en: A specific day of the month or year.
example_en: What is the date of your birthday celebration?
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kuningiz nishonlanadigan sana qaysi?

definition_en: The highest part or surface of something.
example_en: We climbed to the top of the mountain to see the view.
example_uz: Manzarani ko'rish uchun tog'ning cho'qqisiga chiqdik.

definition_en: To express something clearly and formally in speech or writing.
example_en: The report will state the facts clearly for all the committee members.
example_uz: Hisobot barcha qo'mita a'zolari uchun faktlarni aniq bayon qiladi.

definition_en: A message sent from one computer to another using the internet.
example_en: I sent an email to my teacher about the next school project.
example_uz: Men o'qituvchimga keyingi maktab loyihasi haqida elektron xat yubordim.

definition_en: The earth and all the people, places, and things on it.
example_en: There are many different countries all around the world to visit today.
example_uz: Bugun dunyo bo'ylab tashrif buyurish uchun ko'plab turli mamlakatlar mavjud.

definition_en: Coming immediately after the current person, thing, or time.
example_en: We will have our next English lesson on Monday morning at nine.
example_uz: Biz keyingi ingliz tili darsimizni dushanba kuni soat to'qqizda o'tamiz.

definition_en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.
example_en: This is the last piece of cake, so please take it now.
example_uz: Bu tortning oxirgi bo'lagi, shuning uchun iltimos uni hozir oling.

definition_en: Sounds arranged in a way that is pleasant or interesting to listen to.
example_en: I listen to relaxing music when I want to focus on work.
example_uz: Ishga diqqatimni qaratmoqchi bo'lganimda tinchlantiruvchi musiqa eshitaman.

definition_en: Something that is made, grown, or created to be sold to people.
example_en: This new cleaning product is very effective for removing tough stains.
example_uz: Ushbu yangi tozalash vositasi qiyin dog'larni ketkazishda juda samarali.

definition_en: A set of related parts that work together to achieve a specific goal.
example_en: The school has a new system to track student attendance every morning.
example_uz: Maktabda har kuni ertalab o'quvchilar davomatini kuzatish uchun yangi tizim bor.

definition_en: To publish something on the internet for people to see.
example_en: I will post the photos from our trip on my social media.
example_uz: Sayohatimizdan olingan suratlarni ijtimoiy tarmoqlarimga joylayman.

definition_en: To put something together with something else to increase the size or amount.
example_en: Please add a little more sugar to my hot coffee today.
example_uz: Iltimos, bugun issiq qahvamga biroz ko'proq shakar qo'shing.

definition_en: A symbol or word used to represent a specific amount or quantity.
example_en: Can you write down your phone number on this piece of paper?
example_uz: Telefon raqamingizni shu qog'ozga yozib bera olasizmi?

definition_en: A polite word used to ask for something or to make a request.
example_en: Could you please help me carry these heavy bags to the car?
example_uz: Iltimos, bu og'ir sumkalarni mashinagacha olib borishga yordam bera olasizmi?

definition_en: Of the highest quality or more excellent than all others.
example_en: This restaurant is widely known as the best place for lunch.
example_uz: Bu restoran tushlik qilish uchun eng yaxshi joy sifatida keng tanilgan.

definition_en: Computer programs and data that allow a computer to perform specific tasks.
example_en: You need to install the latest software to update your computer system.
example_uz: Kompyuter tizimini yangilash uchun eng so'nggi dasturiy ta'minotni o'rnatishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A recording of moving images and sound that you can watch on a screen.
example_en: I watched a short video about wild animals on my phone today.
example_uz: Men bugun telefonimda yovvoyi hayvonlar haqida qisqa video tomosha qildim.

definition_en: Connected to or shared by all people in a society or community.
example_en: The local library is a public place open to everyone in town.
example_uz: Mahalliy kutubxona shahardagi barcha uchun ochiq bo'lgan jamoat joyidir.

definition_en: Having a large distance from the bottom to the top.
example_en: We climbed a very high mountain during our summer holiday.
example_uz: Biz yozgi ta'tilimiz davomida juda baland tog'ga chiqdik.

definition_en: A report that gives an opinion about a book, film, or product.
example_en: I read a very positive review of the new movie online.
example_uz: Men internetda yangi kino haqida juda ijobiy sharh o'qidim.

definition_en: The state of being alone and free from public attention or disturbance.
example_en: I value my privacy and do not like to share personal details.
example_uz: Men shaxsiy hayotim daxlsizligini qadrlayman va shaxsiy ma'lumotlarimni bo'lishishni yoqtirmayman.

definition_en: An organization that sells goods or services to make money.
example_en: She works for a large company that sells computer software globally.
example_uz: U butun dunyo bo'ylab kompyuter dasturlarini sotadigan yirik kompaniyada ishlaydi.
